name: BTC and ETH daily anchor
start_rule: max of 2020-01-01 and each series valid start
end_rule: latest common valid observation on or before data cutoff
inclusion_rule: BTC and ETH with positive close and identity-resolved source
exclusion_rule: earlier history is a separately labelled diagnostic

name: Stable-core crypto assets
end_rule: latest common valid observation on or before data cutoff
inclusion_rule: non-stable, non-wrapped PIT top-20 member at 2021-01-31; valid by 2021-01-01; at least 95 percent coverage; identity resolved
exclusion_rule: HYPE and assets with unresolved discontinuities

name: Broad unbalanced crypto assets
inclusion_rule: PIT risk asset with at least 365 observations and at least 90 percent coverage since valid start

name: Monthly point-in-time market structure
end_rule: last complete month on or before data cutoff
exclusion_rule: partial months and any daily constituent-performance inference

name: Institutional instruments
start_rule: BTC ETF 2024-01-11; ETH ETF 2024-07-23; other instruments at actual launch
end_rule: latest valid report on or before data cutoff
exclusion_rule: pre-inception and non-reporting dates remain missing
